request.style: English, male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, piano, strings, warm mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Justified by faith we find peace
Through our Lord Jesus Christ
Access gained into grace
We stand in this light

[Chorus]
We boast in our sufferings
Knowing suffering produces endurance
Endurance produces character
And character produces hope

[Verse]
Hope does not put us to shame
God's love poured into hearts
The Holy Spirit given
Is the part we start

[Chorus]
We boast in our sufferings
Knowing suffering produces endurance
Endurance produces character
And character produces hope

[Bridge]
While we were still helpless
At just the right time
Christ died for the ungodly
In His mighty prime

[Outro]
Rarely die for the good
But Christ gave His life
Endurance and hope
Are the result of strife
